game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Collapsed Dome, a collapsed dome: the spirit seeker must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of relic shards while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Collapsed Dome: a collapsed dome
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Dome, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of relic shards while keeping the order. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the rune gate using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The rune gate reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the rune gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 8 (extended tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Duplicate Sweep' (Week 7 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Collapsed Dome'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
